hook.name: DaemonsHook
hook.description: Claims a single canonical ETH/DAEMON v4 pool by enforcing initialization parameters (fee, tick spacing, starting price) in beforeInitialize. After each swap, folds the direction, token deltas, block number, and swap count into a rolling keccak256 hash stored on-chain as "corruption" state, emitted via Mutation events for use by external ERC20/ERC721 NFT renderers.
